ui.chat.header.conversation_name.note: Labels the conversation title input, not the whole header. maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.header.archived_hint.note: Explains why an archived conversation is absent from the chat list.

ui.chat.header.archived.note: State marker, not the archive action. maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.header.actions.note: Opens the current conversation action menu. maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.header.copy_id.note: Copies session ID to clipboard. ID is the existing technical abbreviation. maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.header.move_device.note: Opens destination-device selection; Unicode ellipsis U+2026 must remain in English. maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.header.transcript_display.note: Opens the conversation transcript display-mode submenu; active mode is separately rendered. maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.header.delete.note: Opens permanent-delete confirmation, not immediate deletion. U+2026 in English. maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.header.close_run_details.role: overflow menu item, run-details toggle label while the pane is open
ui.chat.header.close_run_details.note: States the action the row takes: it closes the run-details pane. Its sibling open_run_details carries the opposite state. maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.header.open_run_details.role: overflow menu item, run-details toggle label while the pane is closed
ui.chat.header.open_run_details.note: States the action the row takes: it opens the run-details pane. Its sibling close_run_details carries the opposite state. maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.header.new_chat.role: chat header title for an untargeted new conversation
ui.chat.header.new_chat.note: The stand-in the header wears while a New chat draft has no conversation and no target; the conversation's own name replaces it as soon as one exists. It names the new chat itself, so it is not the New chat control's label elsewhere in the shell (that key is ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.new_chat). maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.header.new_chat_with.role: chat header title for a new conversation aimed at an agent or team
ui.chat.header.new_chat_with.note: {target} is the agent or team's own display name and is never translated. Names the staged draft before it has a conversation; once one exists the conversation's name replaces it. maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.header.archive_conversation.role: header menu item that archives the open conversation
ui.chat.header.archive_conversation.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.header.archive_conversation.note: Lives beside the header's other conversation actions. Archiving hides the conversation from the chats list until it is restored; the same item becomes 'Restore conversation' while the conversation is archived.

ui.chat.header.cancel_rename.role: accessible name and tooltip of the header control that abandons a rename in progress
ui.chat.header.cancel_rename.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.header.cancel_rename.note: Screen-reader and pointer users only: the control is the same pencil glyph the row shows at rest, now acting as the cancel. It appears only while the rename field is open.

ui.chat.header.rename_conversation.role: accessible name and tooltip of the header control that opens the conversation-name field
ui.chat.header.rename_conversation.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.header.rename_conversation.note: Same verb as the sidebar row menu's rename item; this one sits in the open conversation's header. It opens an inline field rather than a dialog.

ui.chat.header.restore_conversation.role: header menu item that restores an archived conversation
ui.chat.header.restore_conversation.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.header.restore_conversation.note: The archived-state face of the archive item: it clears the archive mark instead of setting it, returning the conversation to the chats list.

ui.chat.header.saving_conversation_name.role: accessible name and tooltip of the header control while a conversation-name write is in flight
ui.chat.header.saving_conversation_name.tone: plain statement, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.header.saving_conversation_name.note: Screen-reader and pointer users only: it reports the busy state instead of offering an action, because the control no-ops while the write runs.

ui.chat.header.starting_session.role: Header description while a new session is being created

ui.chat.header.canonical_chat.role: Header description fallback for a session with no known directory
ui.chat.header.canonical_chat.note: Fallback noun phrase; 'canonical' means the native chat view.

ui.chat.header.temporary.note: Marks the open conversation as a temporary chat that the backend deletes after its idle window.

ui.chat.header.temporary_hint.role: native title tooltip on the header toggle and pill
ui.chat.header.temporary_hint.note: 30 min is the backend default idle window; the setting can change it, hence "by default".

ui.chat.header.temporary_toggle_on.role: accessible name of the header toggle while off
ui.chat.header.temporary_toggle_on.note: Shown only on a new chat before its first message.

ui.chat.header.temporary_toggle_off.role: accessible name of the header toggle while on
ui.chat.header.temporary_toggle_off.note: Turns the new chat back into an ordinary one.

ui.chat.header.temporary_ends_in.role: warning pill countdown in the header
ui.chat.header.temporary_ends_in.note: Shown only in the last five minutes before deletion; minutes is a whole number, rounded up.
